title: Domain
description: The domain values of the review tool, the source their classes are generated from

TargetUrl.description: The address of the change to review

Workdir.description: The directory a review is kept in

Surface.description: The lines of a change a review looks at

Probe.description: What a sub agent holds for its part of a review

Probes.description: The probes of the review tool

Rule.description: One rule a change is judged against

Ruleset.description: The rules a sub agent is given

Workflow.description: The steps a sub agent follows

Context.description: What is special for one review

Usage.description: How the review tool is called

AcknowledgementRequest.description: What a sub agent sends back to show it read its instructions

Acknowledgement.description: What a sub agent sent back

Verdict.description: The result of judging a change against one rule

Violation.description: A finding that a change breaks a rule

Outcome.description: What a review posts to the host

NotStarted.description: A sub agent could not be started

TooLarge.description: The change is over a limit

Refused.description: The change is not in a state to review

NotValid.description: What was given does not make a valid value
